load_video_annotations: load COCO video annotations and group frames by video_id into a data list
parse_video_data_info: parse raw image and annotation info into structured instances with bboxes and masks
filter_video_data: filter video frames by category, minimum size, and empty ground truth criteria
prepare_video_data: prepare video or frame-level data through the pipeline for training or test mode
get_video_cat_ids: get category IDs for instances in a specific video or video frame index
